text:
Sam: starting canary for engine-3.15-quant-2026-04-02 on late-window (3%) for 25m. pin-ttl=1800s. release-notes link: https://gist.local/rw/engine-3.15
Nadia: which quant profile and kernel bundle?
Sam: using q4a-lowbit + matmul-v2-kernel (tag mv2-20260402). fallback route to engine-3.14-compat if any failure.
Ethan: add smoke gating after 80 requests: p95 < 140ms, p90 mem < 78%, error-rate delta < 1.4x. if fail -> immediate drain + pin to engine-3.14.
Kai: also add a safety for model-ids that use long prompts (>2048) — route them out of canary for first 30m.
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout id=rb-1791234567-01 -> late-window (canary 3%)
deploy-bot: pinned=false ttl=1800s
Nadia: tagging ops/runbooks/engine-release and paging @oncall-kai. smoke queries posted to monitoring channel.
Kai: oncall here. will watch for KV-cache-growth and matmul flops anomaly. post any "rollback" and I'll act.
Ethan: notes for release-notes: mention binary ABI bump and Dedicated customers need to schedule maintenance if pinned. small blurb drafted.
Sam: adding routing exceptions and trace header x-roll-sample to capture warm starts.
deploy-bot: [smoke] initial n=95 samples: p95=128ms, mem p90=70%, err=0.15%  proceed to 10% at t+10m per plan
Nadia: good. continuing monitor. if anyone sees steady error climb reply with "rollback"
Sam: will update thread when we hit full release or rollback.
